normalization.p: Unicode Normalization Form D (NFD), corpus-wide. Never NFKC.

correction.p: The Russian is reproduced in its pre-1918 orthography, as printed.

The parallel Chukchi text of each tale is not transcribed. It is shown as a facsimile of its band of the page, and its place in the text is marked by gap. Chukchi forms inside the Russian are keyed as printed, in the book's own 1900 notation, and never corrected.

langUsage.language: Russian, in pre-1918 orthography — the text as printed.
Chukchi, in Bogoras's 1900 Cyrillic notation. Tier-1: keyed character by character, never normalized, always carrying a rank in @resp.
English — the translation, authored by this edition.
